agent_priors_used: A pre-freeze design defect (empty sampling frame, absent attainability certificate) is a control failure, not evidence about the scientific question; a cheap pre-freeze certificate decides constructibility before an EXECUTE cycle is spent (general prior on measurement readiness).

When a flagship benchmark is gated on several independent prerequisites, the efficient move is to repair each prerequisite once in the owning lane; repeated full-benchmark attempts while a prerequisite is missing mostly rediscover the same blocker (general prior on path dependence and sequential testing).

A cheap probe that separates two competing explanations (prompt underspecification vs model capability) is higher decision value than another benchmark run on an unverified endpoint (general prior on experimental economics).

A bounded positive result with a known confound should be resolved by removing the confound before adding new mechanisms; otherwise the mechanism inventory grows while causal status stays unknown (general prior on causal identification).

The external validity of the single accepted positive in a research program deserves testing before the result is used as a product prior; single-vantage results are plausibly vantage-specific (general prior on generalization and robustness).

Many consecutive cycles concentrated on one claim yield local refinement that can outlive its decision value; the cognitive reset asks which currently unblocked question most changes a downstream decision (general prior on exploration/exploitation balance).

allocation.question: On a stdlib-only locally served multi-endpoint multi-verb HTTP application whose goal texts are authored by a process that never sees the mechanism intent strings, with a preregistered contamination screen measuring every goal's overlap against EVERY registry intent (not only its own family), a preregistered authoring-provenance record, a reference arm provably distinct from the candidate (the prior argmax-w*cos+b arm was provably identical to the candidate), and positive/null/dynamic-range controls each arithmetically able to fail and live-verified before freeze: does max-cosine-similarity selection over intent embeddings still bind the correct mechanism on goals never seen at authoring time, and by how much does it exceed a token-overlap null on those same independently authored goals - i.e., does the bounded 45/52 vs 33/52 advantage (paired family-blocked difference 0.2308, 95% CI [0.1136, 0.3509]) survive removal of the joint-authorship confound, or was it an artifact of intents and goal templates authored in the same execute-time file by the same agent, with abstention scored as its own class, pooled false-accept <= 0.10, UNKNOWN precision >= 0.85 and ECE <= 0.15 (bootstrap upper <= 0.18)?
allocation.rationale: Cognitive reset: with today's Codex and no handoff, Graph's highest-value question is still whether goal-to-mechanism binding works on independently authored goals, because semantic resolution is presupposed by every downstream inheritance mechanism (parameterized binding, the SPIDER arm of the flagship benchmark) and the only bounded positive signal (45/52 vs 33/52) is under a joint-authorship confound that a single well-controlled experiment can remove or confirm. The C-FRESHNESS four-anchor Part II route is structurally parked (D1V population single-anchor, transport-coupled, time-stable across two capture dates; no constructible redesign on the pinned anchors — EXP-GRAPH-37992949248) and must not be replayed. Three consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID packets (EXP-GRAPH-36272373909, -36279237023, -36287167610) have already identified every satisfiability defect in this design (V9 code-bound unsatisfiable, B-EMBEDDING-ARGMAX identical to the candidate, PC-VERBATIM-INTENT incapable of failing, ece_global<=0.15 unattainable, no-applicable gate inert) — the mandate's six preconditions repair exactly those defects, so the next packet tests the scientific question instead of the control plane. The next result can change the decision: if the advantage survives, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE moves toward EXPERIMENTAL and the resolver path is licensed for the flagship; if it collapses to the lexical null, the embedding-selection route is retired and the resolver must be redesigned before any LLM-inherit benchmark reuses it.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The program is converging on one decisive product question — whether inherited parameterized mechanisms reduce real agent cost per successful task — and it is gated on exactly three prerequisites, all currently in PREFREEZE across the owning lanes: a shipped parameterized carrier with a binding positive/negative certificate (B1, Product), a non-degenerate task bank with a pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate (B2, Runtime), and a programmatic endpoint or bounded negative on local-model capability (B3, Intel). The flagship C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark executions must NOT be funded until all three hold; no lane is therefore assigned a full benchmark this cycle. Outside the flagship, the highest-value open scientific questions are (a) whether fresh-instance acquisition cost scales with Web depth (C-CROSSSITE hop law — never measured; v1 blocked on an empty sampling frame, not on science), (b) whether the bounded 45/52-vs-33/52 semantic-resolution signal survives removal of the joint-authorship confound (C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE — presupposed by every inheritance mechanism), and (c) whether the one accepted Physics positive (intrinsic barrier stationarity, S1_STATIONARY) survives the source-vantage axis it explicitly left open. C-FRESHNESS Part II (four-anchor D1V) is structurally parked: the D1V population is single-anchor and transport-coupled with no constructible redesign on the pinned anchors — do not replay. C-DELTA-REPAIR is a bounded single-node positive; the distributed n>=800 scale-up has low marginal scientific value and is not funded this cycle. The out-of-surface C-MEAS-VALID oracle repair (Connection-header exclusion, stability-gate fix, M-REVERT-LOGICAL) is a known-small repair preserved as a parked prerequisite for real-drift uses, not re-discovered across lanes.
